'''Dragon darts''' are a type of [[Ranged]] throwing weapons. Dragon darts require level 60 Ranged to wield. They can be obtained by using the [[Fletching]] skill, [[trading]] with another player, or via [[dragon impling]]s. Dragon darts can be [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]] and can be wielded with a [[shield]] or [[god book]] for protection, or added into a [[toxic blowpipe]].

To create dragon darts the player must have at least level 95 Fletching. Players must obtain [[dragon dart tip]]s (these cannot be [[smithed]]) and then attach [[feather]]s to the dart tips. 250 Fletching experience is given per set of dragon darts created.

Fletching some dragon darts while in the [[Bedabin Camp]] is required to complete the [[Desert Diary#Elite|Elite Desert Diary]].

==Trivia==
[[File:Toxic blowpipe - dragon darts.gif|thumb|right|200px|The unique projectile animation when using a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts.]]
* As they do not have the colour of [[Orikalkum]], they are most likely made from parts of a dragon instead, similar to [[Dragon arrowtips]].
* Unlike other darts, Dragon darts have a unique projectile animation when thrown or shot out of a [[toxic blowpipe]].
* Dragon darts are the only [[Dragon equipment#Weapons|dragon weapon]] aside from the [[dragon cane]] that does not possess a [[special attack]].
